en: Looks like I'm missing that job interview...
I'll do anything to keep the people of Spanish Harlem safe.
If you need me, I got your back.
Maybe today won't be so boring after all.
I'm a little more subtle than I look.
Pair me up with the right person and this will be over in no time.
Al menos alguien me aprecia. (At least someone appreciates me.)
Hey, maybe I'll make that interview after all!
If you need me, call me.
Tal vez debería comprar tickets for South Pacific. (Maybe I should buy tickets for South Pacific.)
(Alt: Tal vez debería comprar South Pacific tickets. (Maybe I should buy South Pacific tickets.))
Wonder what the Arroyos are up to.
I should go check in on Sophie and see how she's doing.
Go have fun without me. It's ok.
You sure? I can make any team better!
Can I at least have a hug?
Ahh, I guess I'll wait here.
So... you're the Savior of Spanish Harlem, huh?
Heh. Not looking to be deified?
I just wanted to make my neighborhood safe.
The city owes you a debt for taking care of Mendoza.
Humility is good, but word of advice: Don't undervalue your worth.
So, a private detective is a job where you help people, but charge them money?
Help is relative. I'm pretty sure a lot of my clients wished I wasn't honest about what I found.
I'm glad I'm paired with you, and not some coward.
Never confuse the desperate with the courageous.
You shouldn't have saved Spanish Harlem.
Then they should have saved themselves rather than let you do all the work.
You want me to carry you around the city? It's kind of fun!
Might be a little too heavy for you, miss.
I'm stronger than I look, mister golem!
Why do you fight people for money?
Why do you fight people for free?
Because if I didn't, people would have died.
You and Miss Shelly should come over to the Arroyos for dinner sometime. I bet they'd get along great!
That sounds rather nice, Ivy. Thank you!
Oh look, if it isn't Carlos Arroyo's talking billboard for his mayoral campaign.
Yeah, yeah, we all know the stupid story. Lady: he used you to increase the property value of Spanish Harlem, and he's using you to sit in the mayor's mansion!
I don't need to justify shit to Carlos Arroyo's pet gargoyle.
Hey, Billy. So, I was wondering...
You ask me how I got the goat head, I'll bash your skull in.
What? People ask about that? That'd be crazy.
Well, looky here. The Savior of Spanish Harlem herself.
Legends don't get to choose what they're called.
Yes, you are. You know it, and you're afraid of it. Don't be.
Nice to meet you. I'm Ivy.
I don't care what your name is, you'll be dead long before you're relevant in my world.
Look at us. The Sower and the Reaper.
I think you may be confusing me with Mina? I don't know how to sew.
I've never been to a farm.
Sure, but I'm not a farmer, so why would you say that?
You save lives, and I take 'em.
I think your analogies need some work.
It's nice to meet you, Professor. Sophia speaks very highly of you.
That's kind of you to say.
Okay-ish. She's a great student, but... lately she's been falling asleep in class. She says she's been pulling long shifts at her job, and it's wearing her out.
I didn't even know Sophia had a job.
Well, if you could talk to her, I think it would do a world of good.
So, Ivy... how long have you been a vigilante?
Oh, my whole life. It was a calling. But with Mendoza gone, I think I'm ready to find a career.
Well, if we survive and you need a reference, let me know.
You did good things for this city. You should feel proud.
Anyone would have done the same.
No, they wouldn't. That's why it took you to do it.
Ms. Haze, do you think I'd be a good fit for the OSIC?
Of course not. But it means the bad days would stay with you. And in our line of work, you can't let it.
How often do you work with a partner?
Assassination is rarely a team sport.
Well, stick with me. If you let me help you, we can make a lot happen.
Are you angry like, all the time?
You know, my sister told me that when I get mad, I should take a deep breath and count to four. It doesn't always work, but sometimes it does!
Y-yeah, I'm... going to shut up now.
Heard about you on the news.
I am. Turns out lots of people are interested in crimefighting gargoyles.
Were they saying nice things, at least?
Ivy, it's hard not to say nice things about you.
So, what do you think of New York?
I'm here to catch a killer, not go sightseeing.

Ok, so, that's totally fair, but! If you decide to go sightseeing, let me know. I've only recently started leaving Spanish Harlem, so it would be nice to have someone to do stuff with that's not in my family. N-Not that there's anything wrong with my family! I love-
You know, I could use someone like you on one of my expeditions.
Thanks for the offer, sir, but I don't think I could be away from the Arroyos that long.
If you change your mind, let me know.
I know this is an awkward time to ask, but, when this is over, would you be willing to talk to my little brother? He's a big fan of your adventure stories.
I always get a little nervous before I get shot at...
I'm already dead, so the stakes are a little lower.
Looking forward to working with you, Ivy.
You're the only person in New York that Mendoza hates more than me, and that is impressive.
Everyone told me you were going to be mean to me.
Stupid people tend to say stupid things.
Ivy. A plan's a list of things that don't happen. What we need... is The Lash.
Why do you hate Bebop so much?
Carlos says Fairfax Industries is bad for the country.
And if Carlos paid my mortgage, I might care what he had to say.
How can you work at Fairfax Industries?
First up is asking for an application.
Oh, I don't want to work there.
Ohh, so you wanted to have moral superiority over someone you just met.
I read about you in the paper. Thanks for making New York a little better.
You're the gargoyle that rode Mendoza out on a rail, yes?
Why do you help horrible people?
Horrible people tend to have the most money.
Is money all that matters to you?
Parquet floors don't just arrive in your hovel, Ivy.
So. What do you guys do?
I'm not sure how I feel about working with you...
I'm waiting for the other shoe to drop.
Nah, I mean it. You saw the world as it was and decided it was not acceptable to you. That's to be commended.
That being said, if you have an ill-timed bout of heroism and try to stop me from reaching my destiny, I will make you suffer.
I'm surprised you wanted to team up with me.
What I want is to keep an eye on you.
Then watch closely, Ivy. Perhaps you'll learn something.
Good God. You're as nice as people say.
Well, let's see: do you help people for free?
Then yeah. You're killing my business.
I mean, now that's probably all I'll think about too. Thanks.
I mean, I am a gargoyle.
Right... but like... you were stone before you were alive?
Do you know who made you?
Who cares? I was a hunk of rock. My life started when I met the Arroyos. Anything before that... doesn't really matter to me.
I'm in chronic pain and my body is stitched together from corpses I can't identify.
So, Victor... I'm not sure what your plans are after the ritual...
Depends on what I glean from the Patron. Could be anything from doing research, to traveling on a bus, to shaking down a mass murderer.
Oh. I don't know. Get a hot dog?
Together, we're gonna own the skies!
I distinctly see two of us.

Ivy, we're not friends. We are not going on some adventure. When the ritual is over, you will go home to a family, and I will be counting the bodies of the dead. So let's just stay focused on the task at hand.
Carlos always says it takes more muscles to frown than to smile.
Carlos sounds like a preschool teacher.
I was able to clean up Spanish Harlem without murdering everybody.

That you can see, for now. Ivy, some might mistake your naiveté for charm, but believe me when I say: It's dangerous. And if you don't smarten up soon, someone you care about is going to be hurt. Not everyone deserves redemption, and even fewer are capable of it.
Oh, look at that: Everyone's favorite gargoyle showed up.
Ivy, I don't work for Mendoza.
Yeah, of 13 counts! The real number is like, actually way more impressive.
Oh, you're the one wanting to talk shop, don't be mad at me!
Well. If it isn't the loyal pet of the Arroyos...
Vyper. I see you managed not the get stabbed in prison.
Oh, no, no. No, they did stab me, but... y'can't keep a broad like me down!
Yeah, I just wanted to know how you feel about your sister working for Wraith.
Oh my God, wait, you didn't know? [wheeze] This is hilarious! Ha!
What are you talking about, Vyper?!
Sorry, I love hearing about family drama, but I'm not inserting myself in it unless a will's involved. So let's, uh, let's go shoot some people.
It's nice to finally work with you.
Look... I'm a big fan of anyone who makes Mendoza's life hell. Relax. Let's have some fun.
Stay out of Spanish Harlem, Wraith!
Just 'cause Mendoza was run off doesn't mean you get to muscle in.
I saw you poking around the neighborhood.
Try not to sound too excited.
Just not a fan of criminals.
That's just because you haven't gotten to know me yet.
I care what you do, not who you are.
Don't stab me in the back, gargoyle.
お前のみすぼらしい街など興味はなかったが、この手に収めるのも悪くはないかもしれんな。 (I wasn't interested in your shabby town, but maybe it wouldn't be so bad to have it in my hands.)
I'll do my best to slow them down.
New York's about to get a lot more vegetation.
It's not fancy, but it gets the job done!
Sometimes you have to make your own opportunities.
I'll help out however I can.
No es una granada, pero es mejor que na'. (It's not a grenade, but it's better than nothing.)
This might keep them at bay.
The slower they are, the better.
¡No te dejaré ganar! (I won't let you win!)
¡Oh, por Dios, muérete! (Oh, for God's sake, die!)
If I find the right ally, this will be over soon.
Hope I'm working with some team players.
I'll give my allies the chance to shine!
All we need now is a little coordination.
I hope these people know how to use this.
Like Carlos says: you can make opportunities, but you can't make people take them.
We need to move as one!
This can buy me some time.
Being a statue isn't riveting, but it beats being killed!
I'm no good to anyone dead.
I can take care of myself.
Esto debería ayudarme. (This should help me.)
What can I say, I'm a work of art!
I'm not just going to crush them: I'm going to look good doing it!
No one will be able to harm me!
I hope I don't need to use this.
I'm not going down without a fight!
Creen que están ganando? (You think you are winning?)
Necesitas mucho más que eso para matarme. (You'll need a lot more than that to kill me.)
Let me know if you need me to fly in!
I can take to the skies!
Say the word and I can fly in!
God, I hope I get to fly to mid.
Best way to get around the city!
I can fly with the team!
Everyone should get the chance to fly.
The Arroyos always get a kick out of this!
Hope you don't mind the pickup!
¡No voy a morir aquí! (I'm not going to die here!)
¡Nadie amenaza a mis amigos! (Nobody threatens my friends!)
Elegiste la pelea equivocada. (You picked the wrong fight.)
I'd stay down, if I were you.
You tried to punch a gargoyle? Really?!
Well, they had Moxie! I mean, they're dead, but... Moxie!
You think just because you have money you can bully people?!
You think you run this place?
You never should have come here!
Este será un dia largo para tí! (This will be a long day for you!)
Apenas estoy empezando! (I'm just getting started!)
I won't let you hurt my friends!
I'll do whatever it takes to protect my team!
I bet Sophie and Manny would get a kick out of watching me win!
New York is under my protection!
You guys really need to stop fighting me.
I don't know what to tell you, I'm just better at this than you!
Go ahead and waste your bullets!
I'll give it everything I got!
Can't forget to train my abilities.
I need to improve my powers.
Buying a relic could be a good idea.
Might be time to pick up a relic.
Wonder what I can afford now?
Bet there's something good in the shop!
Now I get some quality gear!
I could pick up something nice at the store.
I should check out the store.
Going shopping could be a game changer.
Maybe it's time to buy some real power.
No tienes lo que se necesita. (You don't have what it takes.)
¡Mejor suerte para la próxima! (Better luck next time!)
Who says vigilante work doesn't pay the bills?
The ritual is one step closer.
They can keep the money! We got what we came for.
Where the hell did they go?
That should buy me some time!
I had to get outta there!
Might want to get with the others.
I don't like being this exposed!
Aw man, looks like it's all up to me...
¡Uy, esto es malo! (Oh, this is bad!)
I'll do my best to buy us some time!
Oh boy, there's a lotta them...
We have the Rejuvenator! What's the plan?
Let's regroup and form a plan!
It's time to complete the ritual!
Es nuestro tiempo ahora. (It's our time now.)
Ahora, terminamos lo que empezamos. (Now, we finish what we started.)
I'll be back when I can!
I knew this was going to work out!
So, how are we feeling about this?
Stick close to me, I'll do my best to protect you.
Oh man, Carlos is going to be worried about me.
We need to make this quick: It's Mofongo night.
I hope I don't get Sophie's professor killed.
This is probably less stressful than a shift at the diner.
I need to get back to the Arroyos.
That could have gone real bad!
I'm just glad we survived in one piece!
Sophie was right, you are the best!
Oh man, I don't know what I would do without you, professor.
I don't know how you landed that.
¡Gracias a Dios por ese búho! (Thank goodness for that owl!)
Thanks, Grey Talon, wherever you are.
I get why OSIC hired her.
Thank God you were here, Haze!
We make a hell of a team!
Hey, Kevin... Kelvin! Your name's Kelvin!
Thanks for taking care of me, Kelvin.
Remind me not to piss her off.
Hate to be on the receiving end of that.
I was getting worried for a minute.
Thanks for being on our team, Seven.
I've never seen power like that!
¡Me encanta ese tipo! (I love that guy!)
He's like a shampoo ad with knifes!
Have fun shooting people!.. Oh God, I made that weird.
I don't know how you hit that!
I kind of like it in The Cube!
Arigato! A-did I say that right?!
That woman is scary as hell!
I thought you were one of the good guys, Abrams!
Whew! Finally took out the big guy!
Maybe you should just... spend some time with Ms. Shelly.
No no no no no no!
We're going back to the junkyard.
Gotta be faster than that, Bebop.
I used to think goats were cute.
I won't let you stop me, Billy!
You can't blame the world for your problems, Billy!
You're not picking off my friends, Calico!
Don't worry, Calico. I'm sure the Arroyos will adopt Ava.
She used to be a hero...
Aw man, the Baroness had such a great brunch, too.
I'm pretty sure that's not a normal doorman.
I might want to tell Carlos and Maria to cancel their date night at the Baroness.
I won't let you hunt us!
Leave New York while you can, Drifter!
You're never going to win, Drifter!
I won't let you hurt anyone else!
I think I just beat up Sophie's professor.
Please don't take that out on Sophie, Professor!
Look out for the black hole!
I wanted to respect my elders, but you kinda gave me no choice!
Not a fan of being shot with arrows!
That bow was never going to get it done.
I think I just picked a fight with the feds.
Carlos isn't gonna be wild about me fighting the OSIC.
You're not as sly as you think, Haze.
You can't run from me, Haze!
Normally I'd help you, Holliday. Lo siento. (I'm sorry.)
I'm not letting her lasso me!
And there she goes bouncing away.
I won't let you burn this city down!
What do you think you're doing, Infernus?
That could have gone bad real quick.
You gotta be a lot faster than that, Kelvin.
People like her make the world a worse place.
I can't let someone like her win!
Geist is looking to steal your life!
Huh. Lash really is an asshole.
Buddy, you were supposed to be some genius!
You don't have enough turrets to stop me!
How many of these things does she have?!
Keep building these all you want, McGinnis, they won't stop me!
I'll tear through as many of these as I have to!
Mina, you don't have to be so nasty to everyone!
Hope Sophia doesn't end up like her.
Vampires are a lot more fun when you're reading about them, and they're not trying to kill you.
Mirage shouldn't be a problem for a while.
He'll be back. Need to be careful.
I got nothing against the Djinn, but I can't let you win.
Don't know which is Mo and which is Krill, but they're dead.
One less mole-man to worry about!
I thought they'd be cuddly... They weren't.
And she was so nice when I took Manny to story hour!
We should start a book club after this!
Chacho, I feel kinda bad about doing that to her. (Man)
Ay, she was a tough one!
I am so sick of that lady!
That was never going to finish me off, Paradox!
It'll take a lot more than that, Paradox!
I feel like Pocket just needs a hug.
Pocket shouldn't be bothering us for a while.
I'm just saying, "Siete" is about as un-intimidating a name as it gets.
I won't let you hurt anyone else!
I can't let that monster summon the Patron!
I won't be hunted by you!
What kind of moron tries to stab stone?
Get out of my city, Shiv!
I, uh... I probably shouldn't tell the Arroyos about this.
Sooo, the Vatican sent an assassin? That's... great.
That guy's having a rough day.
I'll help you after the ritual, Victor, but for now, I have to stop you.
I bet I could get Carlos to lend you a shirt.
She won't be happy about that!
And she thought she was safe!
That was one big pile of goo.
That thing is like if Manny's science fair project gained sentience.
Ay, qué rebolo! (Ah, what a mess!)
I stopped you when you worked for Mendoza, and I'll stop you again!
Lady, just turn yourself in and save us some time!
That guy needs to lighten up.
You won't stop me from summoning the Patron, Warden!
Don't let Warden get close to you!
You criminals are all the same!
You don't run New York, Wraith!
Take your card tricks somewhere else!
I don't know what she was saying, but she scared the hell out of me.
I took out Mendoza, and I'll take out you!
Stick with me, Ivy. We'll be doin' this all day!
Maybe there's somethin' to workin' with you after all, Ivy.
Ivy, you're not as bad as I thought!
I'll be with you soon, Ivy.
We make a good team, Ivy.
Ivy, you can work with me whenever you like.
We're makin' this look easy, aren't we, Ivy?
I hope she doesn't find herself in too much trouble.
Ivy, you make for a lovely companion.
You have a gift for demolition, Ivy.
It's always a pleasure to be on your team, Ivy.
If we keep working together, they don't have a chance!
You know what you're doing, Ivy.
I see why you're beloved, Ivy.
We make this look easy, don't we, Ivy?
Ivy, we keep this up and it will be over soon.
If we keep working together, they don't have a chance.
We make a good team, Ivy!
Keep up the good work, Ivy.
When we team up... Magic happens, Ivy.
I'm here for that teather life.
Thanks for having my back, Ivy.
Damn it, they took out Ivy!
Ivy, I knew I could depend on you.
See, Ivy? We can work together.
I'll be back when I can.
No one can actually be that happy all the time.
You know, Ivy, at first I thought you were disgustingly saccharine. But now you're surprisingly useful!
That thing didn't have a chance!
Ivy? I love working with you.
Ivy... you are saccharine, but useful.
It's an honor to fight with you, Ivy.
It's nice not having to work alone.
Be back when I can, Ivyǃ
We make a good team, Ivy.
Told you we'd make a good team, Ivy!
We should work together more often!
I feel pretty guilty about that... Not guilty enough not to punch her again but, still, guilty.
You picked the wrong side, Ivy.
You never should have come for me, Ivy.
You're a noble woman, Ivy. I'm sure we'll meet again.
She fights with emotion… probably why she lost.
Who else wants to fall to my blade?
The Savior of Spanish Harlem herself couldn’t stop me.
I never thought the Savior of Spanish Harlem would be such a coward!
I'll be here all day, Ivy!
I knew Ivy was up to no good.
You ain't special just because everyone loves you, Ivy!
Ivy, you're just Carlos Arroyo's pawn.
I don't buy into the whole "Savior of Spanish Harlem" hype.
I knew you would fly away, Ivy!
I don't see why Mendoza couldn't stop her.
I won't let you get in my way, Ivy.
Ivy, you're not used to fighting a higher class of criminal.
You aren't ready to fight someone like me, Ivy.
Of course she flew away. Why wouldn't she?
I'll give the Arroyos free cotton candy next time they're on Coney, and they'll forget all about this.
Why are you workin' with them, Ivy?
I hate that we're fightin', Ivy.
You have a big heart, Ivy. That won't save you here.
Go home to the Arroyos while you can, Ivy.
I'm not some petty crook, Ivy, you never had a chance!
You can fly, Ivy, but I'll still find you!
Ivy, you’re a good person, and I have no desire to torment you here. Just know this: In five years, one of the Arroyos is going to die, and there is nothing you can do to stop it.
If you’re here with me, who is protecting the Arroyos from Mendoza?
You never had a chance, Ivy.
Optimism was only gonna get you so far.
You never fought someone like me, Ivy.
Come out and face me, Ivy! Unless you want me to pay the Arroyos a visit.
I'll be sure to give my condolences to Sophia, Ivy.
I assure you, Ivy, your behavior will not impact my grading of Sophia Arroyo.
Feel kind of bad about fighting her.
Wish we were on the same side, Ivy.
That should get the gargoyle off our backs for a little bit.
You were a noble woman, Ivy.
I took no pleasure in that, Ivy.
You have a good heart, Ivy... But good hearts don't win wars.
I wish I didn't have to do that.
You didn't give me another choice, Ivy.
Well done, little gargoyle. We'll meet again.
She should've flown away while she could.
Well if it makes you feel any better, Carlos still has my vote for Mayor.
Get your ass back here, Ivy!
I'm waitin' anytime you wanna play, Ivy!
I wish I was fighting alongside you, not against you.
Ivy won't be helping her team for a while.
Ivy, Ivy, Ivy, when will you learn?
You're a glorified garden statue, know your place.
Stick to Spanish Harlem. Here, there are real monsters about.
Love that you hate Mendoza. Hate that you picked a fight with me.
Come at me again, same shit's gonna happen.
Welp, this is what happens when you fight the best.
Wish you were on my team, Ivy.
Appreciate what you did for Spanish Harlem, but I gotta do what I gotta do.
Ivy isn't gonna be a problem.
"I'm the savior of Spanish Harlem!" No, you're a dumb gargoyle and you're dead.
No one likes you, Ivy, they're just pretending.
Tell you what, Ivy, if you ask nicely, I'll let you carry my purse.
You seem like a sweet person, Ivy. You deserve better than this.
You're a long way from Spanish Harlem, Ivy.
A pity, I liked that one.
Don't feel bad, Ivy. Destroying stone is kind of our thing.
I can't believe I got to fight the Savior of Spanish Harlem!
Oh my god, why is Ivy fighting me? Am I the bad guy?
Stay away from me, Ivy! I-I'm not the enemy!
Ivy, you couldn't stop me on your best day!
There's different levels to this, Ivy... You aren't ready.
Stick to petty crooks and Spanish Harlem, Ivy!
Why am I fighting a hero? What's wrong with me?
I want you to be my friend.
One day I'll ride on your back, and it will be awesome!
This is the craziest quinceañera I've ever been to...
Do I look like some petty goon, Ivy?
You've stepped into deep waters, Ivy.
The savior of Spanish Harlem indeed.
I feel bad about putting her down.
Welp... I killed the Savior of Spanish Harlem. That, uh... that feels kinda bad.
You picked the wrong side, Ivy.
Savior of Spanish Harlem my ass...
I'm sorry I have to do this, Ivy.
Why are you helping them, Ivy?
Wake up, Ivy! You're fightin' on the wrong side!
I have nothing to fear from the gargoyle.
And so the gargoyle flies away like the craven huntress she is.
You got in my way, Ivy.
I'm not like anything you've faced before, Ivy.
No point in chasing her down now.
The skies belong to me, Ivy.
That's what a kind heart gets you.
An icon of the community? Yes. A competent killer? No.
You made a home for yourself, Ivy! Enjoy it. Don't throw your life away here.
Well that's not fair! She flies!
Now I know how people feel when I turn into goo.
Ivy, quit making life harder for the rest of us!
"Savior of Spanish Harlem"... man, I could have been the savior of Spanish Harlem... ha, probably would have had to stop working for Mendoza to do it, but people can change.
Yeah, I don't think we're gonna be friends, which is like real shame, because I bet she's too nice to remind people they owe her money.
Man, I could've been the savior of Wisconsin Dells...
You're meddling in things you don't understand, Ivy.
Keep coming at me and I'll make Spanish Harlem the next place I set up shop.
ガーゴイルを仕留めた。
面倒さを片付けてくれたことには感謝するぞ。
次はスパニッシュハーレムをいただくとしよう。お前の無礼さの見返りとしてな。
こんな奴が面倒さを止められるなら、ニューヨークの制圧も難しくないな。
こんな奴のどこが恐ろしいというのだ。
You wish to make life better for the Arroyos? Complete the ritual, Ivy.
To the people of Spanish Harlem, you were a beacon of hope. Now you must inspire your allies.
Sophie is in more danger than she could ever know, but this is your chance to keep her safe.
It's only a matter of time before Mendoza comes for the Arroyos to hurt you. Protect them, Ivy. Summon the Hidden King.
You worry about the future, Ivy, but the unknown need not be something to fear. Complete the ritual, and know your destiny.
Ivy is making short work of our enemies.
I knew we could count on you, Ivy.
You work well with others, Ivy.
The gargoyle is giving us trouble.
We can't let the gargoyle destroy us!
You're lost, Ivy. Directionless. But I see beyond what your heart wants. I see what you need. Summon the Archmother so that she may provide it.
Once, you were the savior of Spanish Harlem, and now you will be a savior to your allies.
I know how much you care for the Arroyos, and their future can be secured. All you need to do is complete the ritual.
Summon the Archmother, Ivy, and know that the Arroyos' kindness to you will be repaid tenfold!

Ivy, your flesh is stone, but your heart is ablaze. For some, such kindness would be their downfall... but for you, it is the source of your strength. And that strength will be needed to complete the ritual.
